## Problem and approach

Describe the maintainer problem, the chosen approach and its tradeoffs.

## Validation

Include the commands actually run and their results. Identify untested paths.

- [ ] Regression and failure-mode tests added or updated.
- [ ] `npm run check` and `npm run test:sdk` pass.
- [ ] `dist/` rebuilt and committed.
- [ ] README, schemas, examples and changelog match the behavior.
- [ ] No secrets, private data, broadened permissions or implicit writes.

## Security and compatibility

Describe changed trust boundaries, API use, costs, permissions and public interfaces.
